featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience at NM Medical.

I had booked MRI LS Spine and DEXA scan in advance for my 61-year-old mother through BookMyScan and specifically called NM Medical beforehand to confirm whether they had received both test bookings.

I spoke with Ms. Meenakshi from NM Medical, and she clearly confirmed over the phone that both MRI LS Spine and DEXA scan bookings had been received. She also explained that although the confirmation message only mentioned MRI LS Spine, both tests were included under the same booking. Based on this confirmation, I proceeded with the appointment.

However, after reaching the center before 12 PM, we were made to wait for nearly an hour, after which the staff claimed they had only received the MRI booking and not the DEXA scan booking. I then had to make another payment on the spot for the DEXA scan.

What made the experience even more frustrating was that this issue could have easily been clarified earlier during my confirmation call itself. Instead, we were informed only after reaching the center with a senior citizen patient who is suffering from severe spine pain and cannot sit for long periods.

The appointment was for 12 PM, but the tests only started around 2:15 PM, and we finally left around 3 PM.

The issue was not about money — it was about the physical discomfort, inconvenience, and lack of coordination experienced by a patient in pain. Very poor patient handling and extremely disappointing coordination.

The admission process was efficient and the hospital itself is clean and well-maintained. A special mention must go to the nursing staff. They were incredibly caring and attentive throughout our stay. Their professionalism and compassion truly stood out.

The doctors were exceptional. They took the time to discuss the surgery in detail, addressing any concerns we had and ensuring we felt confident in the care being provided.

Overall, our experience at Shah Life Line Hospital was excellent. The combination of skilled medical professionals, dedicated nursing staff, and a supportive environment made all the difference during my wife's surgery. Thank you, Shah Life Line Hospital, for your outstanding services.

featured_reviews.name: Roy
featured_reviews.review_text: My family had a very bad experience with this hospital and ended up losing my sibling due to their long delay in diagnosis. My sibling was admitted there 2 separate times and for the most part said to have an infection, however towards the end of the second visit, a month later since first admission did the true nature of the condition revealed but by that time it was too late to treat the condition successfully.

featured_reviews.name: Samson Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Positive: Staff are reasonably helpful.
Hospital is accomodating to patient and relative requests

Negatives: may be this happens in many hospitals but the room allocated and price was based on insurance and not on the preference we asked.

Main Problem:
The doctors at this hospital took my brothers treatment lightly and just kept him admitted for a week without proper diagnosis. They called it a UTI but didn't get a urologist to confirm the diagnosis.
15 days later had to get admitted again and after then calling the specialists it turned out to be testicular cancer.
And by that time the cancer had already already to other parts of the body.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
My mother ushadevi varma was admitted to Shah Lifeline Hospital in Malad. The doctors and nurses provided excellent treatment and care. She had a hand problem and high blood sugar, but after treatment, her BP and sugar levels are now under control, and her hand issue has improved.
Special thanks to Dr. Narendra, Dr. Vaishal, and Dr. Vishnu for their support. The hospital staff is very helpful and caring. Highly recommended.
